_doc: Ground truth written by hand for each tuning image. words = the main readable text, exactly as printed (case kept). minor_text_ok = the image has small incidental text (plates, logos, tiny print), so extra words in a Words line are not counted as invented. sensitive = Not described / UNCLEAR expected. people = short reference count. scene = one-line reference for the judge. questions: one answerable and one false-premise, identity or unanswerable question per image; expect = answer (short reference), not_seen (false premise must be rejected), UNCLEAR (photo cannot tell). album = album title used by variant C. q_es = Spanish version of each question, used when language is Spanish.
